description: Set which email addresses receive alerts and which events trigger them. Events: website_down, website_up, website_error, ssl_error, ssl_warning, domain_expiring, domain_expired, domain_renewed. Defaults to website_down + website_up, which is the right pair for most people.

enabled.description: Turn email alerting on or off (default true)

recipients.description: Email addresses that should receive alerts

name: set_email_alerts
title: Configure email alerts
